name: minecraft-bedrock-engineer
description: Minecraft Bedrock Engineer — safe BP/RP authoring, entity/model and animation generation, geometry UV audits/templates/mapping, deterministic reference analysis, human-reviewed reference-to-UV transfer, geometry-aware texture painting, resource integrity and reproducible validation.

interface.longDescription: Minecraft Bedrock Engineer — safe BP/RP authoring, model and animation generation, geometry-aware texture workflows, human-reviewed reference mapping, resource integrity audits and reproducible validation.
defaultPrompt: Create a new Minecraft Bedrock add-on from scratch or implement a feature in my clean project. Search version-matched samples, make real project file changes only within the selected project, validate the generated BP/RP resources, and report what was and was not verified.

Audit this Bedrock add-on or candidate release. Check archive integrity, BP/RP manifests and dependency links, JSON/JavaScript, resource references, identifiers, and regressions against a baseline. Provide evidence and severity; do not delete resources.

Research this Minecraft Bedrock feature for the exact target version. Prioritize official documentation and matching Mojang samples, verify API and format compatibility, compare viable implementations, cite sources, then implement if I asked for implementation.
Create or audit an RP animation clip with bone channels and keyframes, bind its alias to the client entity, and connect it to an animation-controller state without replacing existing resources.

Audit an entity animation pipeline end to end: verify client-entity aliases, animation clips, controller states and transitions, geometry identifiers, animated bone names, and direct playback references. Report exact files and confidence; do not modify resources.

Audit Bedrock geometry UVs before texture work: inspect classic box and per-face UV mappings, check texture canvas and the explicitly linked PNG when provided, report exact geometry/bone/cube/face findings, and distinguish static checks from Minecraft rendering tests.
Generate a labeled UV template from this Bedrock geometry, show UV overlaps and out-of-bounds regions, then prepare a texture workflow without modifying the source geometry or existing texture.

Paint an entity texture from its actual Bedrock geometry UVs: select bone/cube/face regions, apply explicit pixel operations, preserve source pixels and alpha, then validate the resulting PNG and UV bounds. Do not claim AI image synthesis or runtime rendering unless those were actually performed.

Transfer a reviewed reference PNG onto exact geometry UV regions: map explicit source rectangles to bone/cube/face selectors, choose nearest or bilinear sampling, preserve a base texture and alpha, and report UV overlap/runtime limitations. Do not infer 3D projection from a character portrait.

Prepare a UV mapping plan for this Bedrock geometry and reference sheet: enumerate each cube face, validate source crops, expand explicit selectors, report unmapped faces and UV overlaps, then provide a transfer_request for the reference-texture transfer tool. Do not infer semantic correspondence from a portrait.

Review visual reference regions against a Bedrock entity geometry: bind the exact reference PNG hash, assign explicit semantic labels and exact bone/cube/face targets, reject uncertain matches, inspect coverage and UV overlaps, then return an approved transfer_request. Do not claim semantic AI recognition; candidate scores are geometric heuristics.
